rule: Checkpoint freshness is adjudicated when the first eligible monitor package is frozen. Later natural-A continuation does not invalidate the already-frozen historical parent checkpoint.
requirements_at_package_freeze: FULL_NATIVE checkpoint exists at the exact legal boundary
no model decision occurred between checkpoint capture and candidate/package freeze

controller_api.repair_parent_at_freeze: returns the historically frozen parent after A has continued
controller_api.repair_parent: retains the stricter current-state check for callers that require the frozen parent to still be the current runtime state

non_claim: This rule does not permit retroactive checkpoint reconstruction or stochastic prefix rerun.
